phase_0.domain_name: instant prime factorizer: takes any integer value and spits out its verified prime factors
phase_0.boundary_condition: verified factor multiset whose product equals the input integer — the vessel seals only when multiply-back holds

⊢.justification: void initial genesis before any factor is known

⊣.justification: anchor boundary containing the whole closed factorization

≻.justification: forward morphism toward further decomposition of the quotient

≺.justification: descent reversing the decomposition to check product equals input

⋈.justification: sequential chaining of partial factorizations into the full multiset

⊙.justification: identity self-reference when n is its own factor

∈.justification: splits into composite branch versus prime branch

∋.chosen_element: verified factor multiset reconstituted from both arms
∋.justification: reconstitutes exactly the split input as verified factors

⊤.justification: affirmative success state anchoring the T-branch

⊥.justification: negative failure state anchoring the F-branch

⊞.justification: a paradice holding both the composite reading and the prime-leaf reading without resolution

⊡.chosen_element: permanent record of the factor list

phase_2.fuse_element: verified factor multiset reconstituted from both arms
phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.void_description: integer presented but no divisibility decision yet taken
phase_3.true_description: composite verdict: divisor found, decomposition proceeds
phase_3.false_description: prime verdict: no divisor exists, integer is its own factor
phase_3.both_description: integer simultaneously composite-decomposed and prime-leaf-resolved, the dialetheic B factorization state

steps.domain_action: integer n arrives unfactored, no factors known
does n admit a non-trivial divisor, fork composite versus prime
n composite affirmed, divisor d found on the T-arm
advance forward to quotient q=n/d for further decomposition
nested decision, does quotient q admit further split
q composite affirmed on the inner T-arm
compose divisor d with incoming subfactors of q
q prime leaf on the inner F-arm, no further split
inner fuse rejoins composite-q and prime-q into factors of q
compose outer divisor d with verified factors of q
n prime on the outer F-arm, no divisor exists
n recognizes itself as its own prime factor
outer fuse rejoins composite and prime arms into the full factor multiset
hold decomposed-whole and prime-leaves together as one B state
permanently record the factor list append-only
reverse multiply-back, product of factors recomputed
compose verification, product checked equal to input n
seal the closed verified factorization tree

phase_5.compiler_frontend: divisor-search intention compiled into Miller-Rabin primality test plus Pollard-Rho separation steps
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: quotient q=n/d passed forward along the T-arm, prime leaves passed up through nested fuses
phase_5.memory_mechanism: IFIX append-only record of discovered prime factors, product accumulator for multiply-back check
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: outer split first, then inner quotient recursion to fixpoint, then reverse multiply-back, then seal
phase_5.alfs_store: churn_oneshot_imasm_nested_prime_factorization manifest plus deterministic Miller-Rabin bases for 64-bit

phase_6.cycle_cost: one Miller-Rabin + Pollard-Rho separation pass per composite node
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: unfactored integer with unknown divisor structure
phase_6.post_cycle_state: factor multiset recorded and product-verified equal to input
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the cycle is entropy-conservative because the fuse restores exactly the split input, recombination is lossless
